interpretation: Repair verification: all six audited failure families are absent in this executed corpus. This is bounded evidence, not a proof of complete TypeScript runtime or compiler-target coverage.

findings.title: Cross-file writers leave stale literal values
Normal-completion checks miss binding, iteration, coercion and reference errors
Reflect.set ignores a distinct receiver argument
Direct eval can invalidate established values and callable targets
Class decorators can replace an established constructor target
Same-line aliases receive implementation proof without a precise body range
